messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] pushing session id to url no longer works
parts:
That make sense now that I think about it (same origin policy). 

I think this should be possible to make work. My understanding of what your trying to do is generate a URL with a session identifier and redirect the user to that URL. 

I think what is happening is that inside the iframe, the location is the internal URL (which is used by shinyapps.io for internal purposes). When you modify that location using location.pathname.replace, the parent iframe detects that new URL is a URL that is outside the app (since it doesn't match the top frame URL) and it basically intercepts this and removes the iframe (like if you had a link to some other URL inside your app, the iframe get's removed automatically).

The trick here I think is to generate a URL using the top frame URL, but still change the current iframe's location.

So I think what you need to do here is:

var oldpath = window.parent.location.pathname;
var newpath = oldpath.replace(/\/_w_(\w+)/, "");
var path = location.pathname = newpath;

I have not tested this, but I think it should put you the right track.

-Andy
